verdict: Plain thosai is lighter, about half the calories of tosai masala. Tosai masala is still okay as a main meal.
why: Plain thosai is about 170 kcal, tosai masala around 350 kcal. Almost a 180 kcal difference.
Protein isn't very different (5 g vs 8 g), so the potato filling doesn't add much fullness in terms of protein.
Tosai masala has about 11 g fat vs 4 g, from the potato filling cooked in oil.
Plain thosai is easy to have 2 pieces of. That's still around 340 kcal, the same as 1 tosai masala.
when_a: Tosai masala is okay when it's your only dish, without extra roti or kuih.
when_b: Plain thosai suits a daily breakfast or when you want room in your calories for a protein dish.
tip: Eat thosai with sambar and chutney, and add a boiled egg or a glass of unsweetened milk for protein.

faq.q: Is thosai suitable for losing weight?
faq.a: Yes, thosai is one of the lighter options at a mamak shop. Control the number of pieces and add protein on the side.

faq.q: Is coconut chutney high in calories?
faq.a: It has a bit of fat from coconut. Take just enough for taste and have more sambar.
